about: Maker chip-load tables by bit family/series x cutting diameter (in) x material group. feed = RPM x flutes x chip load. laminate.covers: melamine / laminated chipboard and laminated plywood

kodiak/chamfer-mills.notes: One value per cell. Brass = 'Copper - yellow brass, high lead brass, red brass' (bronze row identical). Plastic row = 'Plastics, acrylics, phenolics - polysulfone'. Uncoated starting values; Kodiak: AlTiN coated up to +40 %. Carbon/graphite (1/2" cell printed .010 after .080 at 3/8") and steel rows left out.

series: 2L end mills (plastic & wood, aluminium, composites, coated, tapered, conical ball)
2l-inc/end-mills.description: 2L 'Feeds and Speeds for Machining with 2L End Mills' (11767R1), chip load IPT at 1/8, 1/4 and 1/2 in.
2l-inc/end-mills.notes: One value per cell, any flute count. Brass = 'Brass/Bronze' (copper alloys: same except .002 at 1/2"). 'Plastics' stored under plastic-soft and plastic-hard; composite = 'Plastics, glass filled (i.e. phenolic)'. Slotting: reduce speed to ~80 % of the low SFM. Iron, steel, nickel and titanium rows left out.

series: VFA variable flute for aluminium (2/3 FL, square, corner radius, rougher/finisher, long reach)
lakeshore-carbide/vfa.description: LakeShore Carbide VFA Technical Data: variable flute for aluminum speeds and feeds (catalog p.21).
lakeshore-carbide/vfa.depth_of_cut: profiling 1 x D, slotting 1/2 x D
lakeshore-carbide/vfa.notes: Image-only PDF, values read from the rendered page. One value per cell, any flute count. Brass/bronze and copper alloys equal aluminium. 'Plastics' stored under plastic-soft and plastic-hard. LakeShore: approximate starting point, coolant blast beneficial.
